primary_depth.basis: A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($1,000,000) still clears inside 50bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '0.5% depth' would read as a limit we found. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.
